needed.evidence: No footway present, pedestrians must walk in the roadway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Informal path partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and create a clear, usable informal path or upgrade to a formal sidewalk on the right side.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections on the informal path
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the informal path to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No crossing facility despite pedestrian demand
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting in an urban area
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for both drivers and pedestrians.
